w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 Night. The lingering Spool gorges at the treeline — 800 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: The Callback stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
firstContext: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
You walk in open-handed, talking — low, steady, unafraid. And impossibly, they listen. They stand down. (Walk In: the fight ends.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🍲 Guizhen cooked for the haven — meals stretched.
The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/12/7), with 7 wave-4 fought, 14 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 1 · Forage 11 · Craft 9 · Talk 20 · Explore 33 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE RELAY — "Teach it to let go."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Sofia Chen ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
